== Card credits ==
The printed credit lines of 1 [[Players Committee]] [[Virtual cards|Virtual card]] name Seth Acree (1 original concept credit).<ref name="labels">[https://github.com/billbisco/swccg-gemp/blob/0bc4377d9dd48a100625e0ec75de6032d2ea92a1/src/gemp-swccg-cards/src/main/resources/card_labels.json card_labels.json] in billbisco/swccg-gemp (commit 0bc4377d9): the printed labels of every Players Committee Virtual card, transcribed from the PC's card images. Field definitions: [https://github.com/billbisco/swccg-gemp/blob/0bc4377d9dd48a100625e0ec75de6032d2ea92a1/docs/card_labels.md docs/card_labels.md].</ref> The credited card is in [[Virtual Block 8]], dated 2012 on this wiki. The credit on [[Assassin's Blaster Rifle|••Assassin's Blaster Rifle]] is shared with [[Card Credits#Matt Jourdan|Matt Jourdan]]. The concept credit also names the event or award the concept came from: 10th Anniversary Design Contest (1 card). The full list of everyone credited is at [[Card Credits#Seth Acree|Card Credits]].
